period_note: Balance-sheet-free, income-statement-only interim snapshot -- Solo/Standalone presumed (see sources.json). Recovered via a Wayback Machine capture of DSE's OWN company page (dsebd.org/displayCompany.php?name=PUBALIBANK), NOT the bank's site -- the technique proven on RUPALIBANK, applied here for the first time to PUBALIBANK. This vintage of the table (titled 'Financial Performance: <year>', pre-2016) gives only Turn Over, Net Profit After Tax (Continuing Operations), Basic/Diluted EPS and NAV per share, ALL CUMULATIVE FROM JAN 1 per the table's own column headers (Q1=3 Months, Q2=6 Months, Q3=9 Months) -- no period-end market price is given in this table vintage (the top-of-page 'Last Trade' price reflects the capture date, not the quarter-end, so it is not usable and not recorded). Sourced from DSE's (dsebd.org) own company-page interim table, NOT the bank's own site (pubalibangla.com, Cloudflare-blocked). Solo/Standalone basis presumed, consistent with this bank's established series basis, but not explicitly labeled solo vs consolidated on the DSE page itself -- flagged as an assumption, not a confirmed fact (same caveat documented for RUPALIBANK's use of this identical source type). Clean reconciliation throughout at a constant 838,451,250-share count (308.37/838.451=0.368; 1125.97/838.451=1.343; 1325.34/838.451=1.581 -- all match reported EPS closely) -- the 21/08/2013 AGM (for FY2012) declared a cash-only dividend, no bonus issue, so no Q1-vs-Q2 share-count discontinuity this year.
